newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master says Anchor seeks talks.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master says Anchor seeks talks.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Monday that Anchor Gaming initiated discussions about a possible business combination, but the company does not intend to pursue the talks.
Shuffle Master also said it expects Anchor Gaming will now file a lawsuit against it, charging Shuffle Master's Let It Ride game infringes certain Anchor Gaming patents.
Shuffle Master said the game is protected by valid patents and will vigorously defend against any charges of infringement.
If Anchor Gaming files the suit, Shuffle Master said it would seek damages for unfair competition, abuse of process, and other claims. It would also seek punitive damages.

"Our feeling is that the timing of Mr. Fulton's lawsuit, if served, would be a blatant attempt to pressure Shuffle Master into some form of business arrangement with Anchor Gaming that would clearly be counter to the interests of our stockholders," Shuffle Master chairman John Breeding said in a release.

Shuffle Master said it may also try to invalidate Anchor Gaming's patents by filing reexamination proceedings with the United States Patent and Trademark Office alleging invalidity on the basis of obviousness and existing prior art.
